hints.title: Circular Unrolling
hints.text: Unroll the circular sequence of length n into a linear sequence of length 2n to represent all boundary split points.

hints.title: Partition Invariant
hints.text: Observe that any valid partition of the full cycle partitions all elements without overlap.

hints.title: Optimal Substructure
hints.text: Evaluate partition dynamic programming over intervals of length n.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all circular cuts without exploiting sum invariance causes exponential combinatorial branching.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize conservation of total sum across disjoint cyclic partitions.
